verdict.rationale: Crossplane's core purpose is to expose declarative, machine-readable APIs on the Kubernetes control plane that "humans, automation, and AI systems can safely act on". Managed resources and Composite Resource Definitions extend the Kubernetes API with typed schemas, and RBAC governs access. Community comments corroborate that developers interact through these API interfaces and GitOps workflows. Missing for 10: an explicit API reference or schema documentation in the evidence, and independent hands-on evidence of AI agents actually driving these APIs.
